1949 CONVENTION TO BE HELD WITH
THE ZETA CHAPTER

Home of the Zeta

1949 Annual Convention of the Psi Upsilon Fraternity wiH be held on Monday,
THE
Tuesday and Wednesday, June 20, 21 and 22, under the auspices of the Zeta Chapter,
at Hanover, New
Hampshire. This will be the 107th Convention of Psi Upsilon, held in
the 116th year of the Fraternity.
The Zeta Chapter is 107 years old, having been founded on May 10, 1842, seventy-two
years after the founding of Dartmouth College. It was the first chapter of any social
Greek letter Fraternity to make its home on the Dartmouth campus, although the fourth
chapter of Phi Beta Kappa had been, established there in 1787. The Zeta Chapter House,
shown above, was built in 1908 and remodeled in 1940.
